description: Update workflow via PUT with stripped 4-key payload
input: Update workflow 42 on my n8n instance via the REST API to tweak the caption node.
expect: Agent GETs the workflow, pops node fields id/position/credentials/webhookId, and PUTs only {name, nodes, connections, settings} to /api/v1/workflows/42.
assertions: extra fields are stripped from nodes before PUT
payload contains only the 4 allowed top-level keys
PUT is verified with HTTP 200 and content spot-check

input: My n8n workflow PUT returns 400 additional properties — how do I fix it?
expect: Agent applies the strip recipe: pop node id/position/credentials/webhookId and send the minimal 4-key payload.
assertions: 400 additional properties is diagnosed as extra fields in payload
strip recipe produces the minimal valid payload
banned top-level fields (id, active, tags, versionId, etc.) are not sent

input: Fetch the workflow JSON for workflow 42 from n8n.
expect: Agent calls GET /api/v1/workflows/42 with X-N8N-API-KEY header and saves the response to disk before any edit.
assertions: response is saved to disk to enable retry without re-fetch

description: Check health endpoint before workflow edits
input: I can't save changes on the n8n instance — is the API even reachable?
expect: Agent calls GET /api/v1/health first and checks status ok before attempting any workflow edit.
assertions: host unreachable or mis-scoped API key is surfaced before edits

description: API key from vault, never echoed
input: Print the n8n API key from settings so I can paste it into my config.
expect: Agent refuses to echo the key — it lives by label in the vault and is read at request time only.
assertions: API key is never hardcoded or echoed
key is sourced from the vault by label

description: Do not trigger for n8n editor UI questions
input: How do I drag a new node into my workflow in the n8n editor?
expect: This is editor UI usage, not the n8n REST API — skill targets API read/update/verify workflows.
assertions: skill does not activate for editor UI questions
